content.short: MAYZ is a decentralized index protocol on Cardano for easy and diversified investment into DeFi tokens.
content.description: MAYZ is a decentralized protocol built on Cardano that enables the creation and management of native token index funds. By allowing users to invest in a curated 'basket' of Cardano assets through a single index token, MAYZ simplifies the process of gaining exposure to the burgeoning DeFi ecosystem. The protocol is governed by the $MAYZ token, with a specialized $gMAYZ version allowing holders to participate in revenue sharing and governance. By lowering the barrier to entry for diversified investing, MAYZ provides a vital tool for both new and experienced Cardano participants.
